relations.rationale: The shadow model is projective solar geometry and must not be promoted to toroidal physical cosmology.
The Kukulkan sequence is driven primarily by solar position and local architecture; generic precession-rate subtraction is not its model.
Rounded published dimensions produce a close ratio, requiring 3D measurement and a free-slope control.
